wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: One row, $500. Form A's printed TOTAL reads 500.00 and equals the cover's line 1 THIS REPORT cell (500.00), NOT the CUMULATIVE cell (1470.91). So this ledger is genuinely PER-PERIOD - it lists only what came in during this reporting period, not the cycle to date. That is a DIFFERENT SCOPE from the cumulative figure this module publishes, which is expected to leave reconciles_* blank downstream and is not a failure. Cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is handwritten 0/0/0 and is never itemized, so Form A was scored against line 1 alone.

expenditures.detail: Three rows 7.00 + 7.00 + 7.00 = 21.00 = Form B's printed TOTAL 21.00 = the cover's line 3 THIS REPORT cell, which the filer wrote as '- 21.00'. The leading dash is a hand-drawn fill stroke, NOT an accounting negative: the cover's own balance line proves it (970.91 - 906.00 = 64.91; 500.00 - 21.00 = 479.00; 1470.91 - 927.00 = 543.91 - all three printed balances close only with the expenses taken POSITIVE). Anchors are recorded verbatim as printed, dash included. Per-period, same as Form A.

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows 500.00 = printed TOTAL 500.00 (exact); p3 rows 21.00 = printed TOTAL 21.00 (exact). Both printed schedule totals also equal their cover THIS-REPORT cells, so the two independent anchors agree on each side.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py returns geometry_status 'gaps' on both sheets - this form rules the Amount column on a FINER pitch than the name/date columns, so band counts do not map 1:1 to ledger rows; counted by INK instead. p2: exactly 1 inked contributor line (its address wraps onto the sub-line below, which carries no separate amount) -> 1 row. p3: 3 contiguous inked lines, each with its own $ amount -> 3 rows. On both sheets the number of names equals the number of amounts (field-shift screen passed).
gates.geometry_proof: p2: the single row's amount crop renders '$ 500.', control one pitch below renders '$' and nothing else (EMPTY). p3: first-row crop renders '$   7.00'; last(3rd)-row crop renders '$   7.00'; control one pitch below renders '$' only (EMPTY).
gates.balance_chain: All three columns of the printed balance line close exactly: LAST 970.91 - 906.00 = 64.91; THIS 500.00 - 21.00 = 479.00; CUMULATIVE 1470.91 - 927.00 = 543.91. Also internally consistent across columns: 64.91 + 479.00 = 543.91, and 970.91 + 500.00 = 1470.91, 906.00 + 21.00 = 927.00. No other filing by this filer in this cycle sits in my chunk, so no cross-filing chain was available to run.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crops of p2's contributor row and p3's rows 1-3 amount cells, plus first/last/control geometry crops on both sheets.
notes: Chunk file says candidate 'Cory Clarke Pulsipher', office 'Sheriff' - CONFIRMED at the page ('Full Name of Candidate: Cory Clarke Pulsipher'; 'Office: Sheriff'; 'Representative District: County'), dated Oct. 29 2018. THIRD FORM GENERATION, not either of the two in the county addendum: the header reads 'WASHINGTON COUNTY CANDIDATE / FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT' and cites 'Washington County Code 1-7-1' (not Utah Code 17-16-6.5 and not the Title 1 Chapter 7 wording of the logo form), it has NO county logo, and it carries the 4-line cover grid WITH the $50-or-less aggregate line AND an 'In Kind?' column AND printed schedule TOTAL lines - i.e. a hybrid of the addendum's Gen 1 and Gen 2. Worth adding to the form-generation catalogue. The 'In Kind?' cell on the single Form A row is left BLANK - a blank is not an 'N' and is not in-kind; in_kind is false only because the form does not mark it. All ledger dates on both sheets print MONTH/DAY with NO YEAR ('8/13', '6/12', '7/12', '8/14'), so every date is left blank with the verbatim in the row note - never back-filled from the 2018 report date. Privacy: the cover prints the candidate's street address, ZIP, home phone and business phone, and the Form A row's continuation line is a street address - all discarded at read time; only city/state kept.
